prompt: Act as expert in mathematics. Write master thesis about advanced mathematical aspects of Phased Antenna Arrays.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the most faithful to the requested “master thesis” format (clear multi-chapter structure, table of contents, and largely plausible references) and stays comparatively less speculative. Candidate 2 leans heavily on advanced-sounding but internally dubious concepts and likely-fabricated citations, with several nonsensical technical claims. Candidate 3 provides some standard phased-array math (array factor) but includes highly suspect “optimal” formulas and unverifiable simulation outcomes. Candidate 4 is more coherent on the topics (mutual coupling, non-linear/kernel methods) but also introduces strong, unverifiable claims and at least some likely fabricated references.
